subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: After the correctness fixes and consumer proof, should persona SecretRef collection land only after or alongside the narrow optional-TTS startup handling in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265, or should maintainers intentionally accept fail-fast startup for missing persona TTS keys?
rationale: This PR fixes a valid security-sensitive credential-resolution gap, but activating the new targets can expose existing users to a new Gateway startup failure when an optional TTS credential is absent; code review cannot choose that upgrade tradeoff.

options.title: Coordinate startup-safe landing
options.body: Fix this PR, prove the real consumer path, and land it after or alongside an approved narrow missing-TTS startup policy so persona SecretRefs do not introduce a new Gateway outage mode.

options.title: Accept current fail-fast policy
options.body: Land the corrected collection fix independently and explicitly accept that missing active persona TTS SecretRefs remain fatal at Gateway startup.

options.title: Pause both changes
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers settle the broader required-versus-optional TTS credential contract and its status and doctor behavior.

recommendation.title: Coordinate startup-safe landing
recommendation.body: Fix this PR, prove the real consumer path, and land it after or alongside an approved narrow missing-TTS startup policy so persona SecretRefs do not introduce a new Gateway outage mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged SecretRef architecture and its fail-fast activation model originate in their feature work, making them the strongest available owner for this compatibility choice.
